title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
summary: In an announcement on Wednesday, the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative. With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space, including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency […]
title_en: FCC approves SpaceX's plan for up to 1 million AI data center satellites
title_zh: FCC批准SpaceX部署多达100万颗AI数据中心卫星的计划
summary_en: The FCC authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites under its "Starmind" initiative, the first such approval as Google and Blue Origin also pursue space-based AI data centers.
summary_zh: 美国联邦通信委员会批准SpaceX在“Starmind”计划下部署多达100万颗搭载AI芯片的卫星，这是该机构首次批准此类项目，谷歌和蓝色起源也在探索太空AI数据中心。

title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
summary: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.
title_en: New York Bans AI Chatbot Toys for Five Years
title_zh: 纽约禁止AI聊天机器人玩具五年
summary_en: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years, citing Common Sense Media research showing safety failures like inappropriate content exposure and risks to children's emotional development.
summary_zh: 纽约州宣布禁止AI聊天机器人玩具五年，依据Common Sense Media研究，此类玩具存在不当内容暴露及危害儿童情感发育等安全隐患。

title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
summary: The proposed Character.ai bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, the state AGs said.
title_en: State AGs Challenge Character.AI's Plan to Auction Users' Private Chats
title_zh: 多州总检察长反对Character.AI拍卖用户私密聊天记录的计划
summary_en: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI's proposed bankruptcy sale, which would include sensitive personal data from over 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors.
summary_zh: 多州总检察长反对Character.AI破产出售计划，该交易涉及逾2100万美国账户的敏感个人数据，其中210万为未成年人注册账户。

title: Nvidia sellers seek new buyers as U.S. curbs China AI chip access, sources tell CNBC
summary: Nvidia GPU sellers are seeking new buyers after new U.S. rules tightened remote access to advanced AI chips for China-linked customers
title_en: Nvidia Sellers Seek New Buyers as U.S. Curbs China AI Chip Access
title_zh: 美国限制中国获取AI芯片，英伟达卖家另寻买家
summary_en: Nvidia GPU sellers are seeking new buyers after new U.S. rules tightened remote access to advanced AI chips for China-linked customers, CNBC reported, citing sources.
summary_zh: 据CNBC报道，美国新规收紧与中国相关客户对先进AI芯片的远程访问后，英伟达GPU卖家正寻找新买家。

title: AI data centers are becoming harder to build, and neoclouds are feeling it
summary: ⁠Nvidia has made clear⁠ it won’t backstop an AI data center until it’s nearly ready to run, and that’s landing just as neoclouds report construction delays and more expensive debt. The message to developers is that land, power, and a finished building matter more than a pitch deck. ⁠Anita Verma-Lallian⁠ has been selling exactly that. […]
title_en: AI Data Center Builds Get Harder as Neoclouds Face Delays and Costlier Debt
title_zh: AI数据中心建设难度加大，新型云厂商面临延期与债务成本上升
summary_en: Nvidia won't backstop AI data centers until nearly operational, as neoclouds report construction delays and pricier debt. Developers now need land, power, and finished buildings more than pitch decks.
summary_zh: 英伟达表示，AI数据中心接近投入运营前不会提供担保；与此同时，新型云厂商报告建设延期和债务成本上升。开发商如今更看重土地、电力和已建成的设施，而非商业计划书。

title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
summary: Most codes of conduct serve as a reflection of corporate culture. In Nvidia's case, that could have consequences.
title_en: Jensen Huang Broke Nvidia's Code of Conduct, and Employees May Not Forget It
title_zh: 黄仁勋违反英伟达行为准则，员工恐难释怀
summary_en: TechCrunch examines how Jensen Huang's breach of Nvidia's code of conduct could affect corporate culture and employee trust, given that such codes typically reflect company values.
summary_zh: TechCrunch分析黄仁勋违反英伟达行为准则一事，探讨此举对企业文化和员工信任的潜在影响，因行为准则通常体现公司价值观。

title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
title_en: OpenAI Merges ChatGPT Chat and Work, Adds Unified Usage Meter
title_zh: OpenAI合并ChatGPT聊天与工作模式，推出统一用量计量
summary_en: OpenAI is combining its ChatGPT Chat and Work experiences under a single usage meter, meaning heavy users may reach limits sooner as the two modes share one quota.
summary_zh: OpenAI将把ChatGPT的聊天与工作模式合并，采用统一用量计量，两种模式共享额度，重度用户可能更快触及使用上限。

title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
summary: Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users. The patent has been rejected, but unfortunately, Google might appeal or resubmit an amended version, and we could see this monstrosity come […]
title_en: Google's patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment's future
title_zh: 谷歌定制AI视频流专利描绘娱乐未来的黯淡图景
summary_en: Google filed a patent for 'My Channel,' a system generating personalized AI-made videos and ads from user data. The patent was rejected, but Google may appeal or resubmit an amended version.
summary_zh: 谷歌申请了一项名为“My Channel”的专利，该系统利用用户数据生成个性化AI视频和广告。该专利已被驳回，但谷歌可能上诉或重新提交修改版本。

title: Tech stocks sink but close well off the lows, Anthropic struggles to rebound above IPO price
summary: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks.
title_en: Tech Stocks Sink but Close Off Lows; Anthropic Struggles Below IPO Price
title_zh: 科技股下挫后收窄跌幅，Anthropic难以回升至IPO发行价上方
summary_en: Nvidia and other AI-linked stocks fell as investors weighed AI spending, inflation and higher-rate risks, though tech shares closed well off session lows. Anthropic continued to struggle to rebound above its IPO price.
summary_zh: 英伟达等AI相关股票下跌，投资者权衡AI支出、通胀及利率上升风险，但科技股收盘远高于盘中低点。Anthropic仍难以回升至IPO发行价上方。

title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
title_en: Anthropic's Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI 'absurd'
title_zh: Anthropic的达里奥·阿莫代伊称向AI交出人类控制的指控“荒谬”
summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei rejected rival claims that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.
summary_zh: Anthropic首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代伊驳斥竞争对手的指控，否认他主张将人类自主权交给AI，尽管领先AI公司正日益自动化自身研究与模型开发。

title_zh: AMD 联合中科慧灵完成人形机器人端侧 AI 验证，探索“大小脑”双处理器架构

title: Saudi national in OpenAI bugging case is out on bond after DOJ tries to block release

summary_en: Abdulrahman Alfozan, a former OpenAI engineer accused in a bugging case, is out on bond and expected to wear an ankle monitor, his attorney said, after the DOJ tried to block his release.
summary_zh: 前OpenAI工程师阿卜杜拉赫曼·阿尔福赞在窃听案中获保释，预计将佩戴电子脚镣，其律师称司法部此前曾试图阻止其获释。

title: Nothing offers a full look at its AI earbuds and charging case
summary: Nothing is showing off a much more detailed look at its upcoming AI earbuds ahead of their December 8th release. The Ear Note buds can record your calls, while their charging case can record, transcribe, and summarize your conversations. Like the Ear 3, the Ear Note's microphone-equipped case comes with a "Talk" button that you […]
title_en: Nothing Reveals Full Look at AI Earbuds and Recording Charging Case
title_zh: Nothing全面展示AI耳机及可录音充电盒

summary_zh: Nothing在12月8日发布前详细展示了新款Ear Note AI耳机。耳机可录制通话，配备麦克风的充电盒可通过“Talk”按钮录制、转写并总结对话。

summary_zh: 据CNBC报道，被控在OpenAI总部高管会议室安装录音设备的阿卜杜勒拉赫曼·阿尔福赞将以100万美元保释金获释。
